Cargo

Ventilação fechada

Method of venting tank vapours through a controlled, closed system to prevent release of gases to the atmosphere, complying with port and MARPOL requirements.

What is Ventilação fechada?

In this glossary, Ventilação fechada refers to: Method of venting tank vapours through a controlled, closed system to prevent release of gases to the atmosphere, complying with port and MARPOL requirements.

How is Ventilação fechada used in maritime?

In maritime communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Terminal para navio: Assegure-se de que os procedimentos de ventilação fechada sejam aplicados durante todas as operações de carregamento no cais."
